## Chinese
Original
### 新馬小雜燴 - 學術時裝展 (2)
 **光頭 B, R. Incognito, 柯爾焚**
結構馬克思主義者亞爾杜塞爾(Althusser)認為意識形態是個人和他們實在物質情况之虛幻關係表象。換句話說,意識形態是被神秘化的結構系統,有物質性的存在。他的意思是個別主體的意念存在是有「物質基礎」,人類的實踐活動是在既定的物質性意識形態機器中進行,生產關係透過意識形態國家機器(Ideological State Apparatuses)及壓抑性國家機器(Repressive State Apparatuses)便可以延續及再產生。而意識形態的功能是黏結社會及維持統治階層的權勢。
壓抑性國家機器(例如警察、軍隊等)利用暴力壓抑(或合理地使用暴力的權利)運作,它是由有統治權勢的階級控制。意識形態國家機器則透過各種制度(家庭、學校、教會、政黨等)來鞏固統治階級的權力。ISA是多元及有相對自主性的,資產階級和無產階級的鬥爭和矛盾也在ISA中具體表現出來。
亞爾杜塞爾相信意識形態的主要運作形式是透過「主體範疇」(category of the subject)使個體構成「個別主體」,而主體範疇是指一些絕對及唯一主體的概念,意識形態結構是一個類似「反射鏡」結構 (mirror-structure),它有雙重反射性(doubly speculary),意思是說絕對主體 (Absolute Subject) 將個體主體化,使他們以為自己是有自由意志及抉擇的主體。
Barthes, Greimas, Kristeva, Coward, Ellis 等採用符號學來研究意識形態。意識形態是一些二次的符號系統(second-order semiological system),根據Barthes 早期的說法,「二次」是指言語中隱藏在指示層面內 (level of denotation) 的意指層面 (level of connotation)。
言語是由表示平面 (plane of expression) 或意符 (signifier) 及內容平面 (plane of content) 或意念 (signified) 所組成的意義系統 (system of significations),言語的意義就是意符和意念的關係。當言語成為另一個意義結構(所謂神話/意識形態)的意符,這些意符也不會失掉其本身的意義結構,閱讀意符中的意識形態訊息或神話都會頗困難,因為這些意符同時有兩種意義——其「自然」意義及其「修辭」意義(渾沌及潛在的)。在論述 (discourse) 中的解碼過程 (deciphering process) 是將意指/神話層面的「密碼」顯露出來,意識形態分析可以認識這些訊息的結構。
Kristeva, Sollers, Baudry, Barthes, Coward 及 Ellis 等企圖將結構馬克思主義、符號學及心理分析(Lacanian Psychoanalysis)連繫。
Kristeva 相信符號是意義的產物及意義生產的過程,讀本 (text) 在產生過程中出現了意識形態,所以意識形態並不是早期 Barthes 所說的二次的符號系統,而是將意義生產化成單一及「自然」意義的系統。
Coward 及 Ellis 利用Lacanian Psychoanalysis 來研究主體構成之過程及主體相對於言語的位置。根據他們的說法,意識形態是表象的實踐活動,生產一些特定的接合(specific articulation),接合是指意義結構的生產及維持意義結構的主體。
所謂「主體」是在人類實踐活動中出現,這些主體被一些表象/意識形態影響,潛意識地控制這些「主體」的行動及思想,雖然這些「主體」是由意識形態及表象所產生,他們卻以為自己是生產者。意識形態將「讀本」的意義及解釋「封閉」,限制了「主體」,使「自我」(ego)得以連續,「封閉」了主體的矛盾性。
除了以上結構主義者對意識形態的看法外,還有歷史主義者 (Historicist school)、心理分析的看法……等,因為篇幅關係,我們只粗略地介紹歷史主義者 (Gramsci, Mannheim 及 Goldmann 等)的概念。
葛蘭西 (Gramsci) 認為意識形態是矛盾現實的超結構表現,結構及超結構形成一個歷史組合 (Historical Bloc)〔超結構(superstructures)是社會生產關係的反映〕。超結構是客觀地存在,這些超結構使人類意識到他們的位置及目標。意識形態是階級的世界觀,馬克思主義則是「最能意識到階級矛盾」的「意識形態」。西方社會主要是由公民社會所支配,統治階級可以利用意識形態霸權 (ideological hegemony) 來控制其它階層。
Mannheim 相信文化及其產物是可以利用當代的世界觀 (Weltanschauung) 來解析,文化客觀過程 (cultural objectivation) 有三個層面的意義:客觀意義 (objective meaning)〔認知一些行為〕;表達意義 (expressive meaning)〔主體主觀之意向〕;及文據意義(documentary meaning)〔對行動分析的整體意義〕。文據的詮釋是受到詮釋者在歷史中的位置所影響。
當作者將其思想和他的社會位置連繫時,「自身相對化」(self-relativization) 也產生。意識形態的觀念透過這個過程發展。從一個歷史角度來看,意識形態是由一個個別構想發展成一個整體的構想,Mannheim 稱一個普遍的完全構想為知識社會學(sociology of Knowledge)。
意識形態的個別構想只是針對片面的意識批評,導出其中的謬誤,個別構想是在心理層面進行。至於全面構想是和一個時代或社會群體的世界觀有關,它的運作範疇是社會性的。
當知識社會學可以確立,一個普遍的完全構想 (general total conception) 使所有社會知識變成科學研究,它的任務是將每一個社會的思想相對化。換句話說,意識形態之理論是用來揭發人類利益團體(例如政黨)的虛假及掩飾,而知識社會學是分析知識的片面性(因為知識是由社會決定的)。
Goldmann 提出「發源結構主義」(genetic structuralism), 他相信人類的行為都可以由研究者提出的「意義結構」(Significative structure) 所闡釋,每一個局部的結構可以為一個較廣義的結構解釋,而這個局部結構又可以為它本身的描述所明瞭。社會現象只可以透過規劃這些現象的結構解釋,而這些規劃結構是人類實踐活動的結果,有著時間歷史性,隨著發展改變。
在分析「讀本」時,Goldmann 利用階級世界觀(class Weltanschauung)作為結構。文學及哲學作品被視為階級世界觀的轉移。他認為意識形態是局部的及歪曲的,其作用是保持階級的位置及利益。
參考書籍:  
Jorge Larrain, _The Concept of Ideology_  
Coward and Ellis, _Language and Materialism_  
Mannheim, _Ideology and Utopia
## English
translated by Gemini Aug 2026
**Structuralist Marxist Louis Althusser** holds that ideology is the imaginary representation of the relationship between individuals and their real material conditions. In other words, ideology is a mystified structural system that possesses a material existence. What he means is that the existence of an individual subject's ideas has a "material basis": human practical activity takes place within a given material ideological apparatus, and relations of production are able to be perpetuated and reproduced through Ideological State Apparatuses and Repressive State Apparatuses. The function of ideology is to bind society together and sustain the power of the ruling stratum.
The Repressive State Apparatus (the police, the military, and so on) operates through the suppression of violence — or, more precisely, through the legitimate right to use violence — and is controlled by the class holding ruling power. The Ideological State Apparatus, by contrast, consolidates the ruling class's power through various institutions (the family, the school, the church, political parties, and so on). The ISA is plural and relatively autonomous, and the struggles and contradictions between bourgeoisie and proletariat are also concretely expressed within it.
Althusser believes that ideology's primary mode of operation is through the "category of the subject," which constitutes individuals as "individual subjects." The category of the subject refers to certain absolute and singular concepts of the subject. The structure of ideology resembles a "mirror-structure," possessing what he calls a "doubly speculary" character — meaning that the Absolute Subject subjectifies individuals, causing them to believe they are subjects possessed of free will and the capacity for choice.
Barthes, Greimas, Kristeva, Coward, and Ellis, among others, have taken up semiotics to study ideology. Ideology is a kind of second-order semiological system; according to Barthes's earlier formulation, "second-order" refers to the level of connotation hidden within the level of denotation in speech.
Speech is a system of significations composed of a plane of expression (or signifier) and a plane of content (or signified); the meaning of speech is the relationship between signifier and signified. When speech becomes the signifier of another structure of meaning (a so-called myth/ideology), these signifiers do not thereby lose their own original structure of meaning — which is precisely why reading the ideological message or myth embedded within a signifier proves so difficult: these signifiers carry two meanings simultaneously, their "natural" meaning and their "rhetorical" meaning (the latter chaotic and latent). The process of deciphering within discourse is what exposes the "code" operating at the level of the signified/myth; ideological analysis is able to identify the structure of such messages.
Kristeva, Sollers, Baudry, Barthes, Coward, and Ellis, among others, have attempted to draw connections among structuralist Marxism, semiotics, and Lacanian psychoanalysis.
Kristeva holds that the sign is both a product of meaning and part of the process of meaning-production; ideology emerges within the text (_text_) during this productive process. Ideology, on her account, is therefore not the second-order semiological system that the early Barthes described, but rather the process by which meaning-production is congealed into a single, "natural" system of meaning.
Coward and Ellis draw on Lacanian psychoanalysis to study the process of subject-formation and the subject's position relative to speech. On their account, ideology is a practice of representation that produces specific "articulations" — an articulation referring both to the production of a structure of meaning and to the subject that sustains that structure.
The so-called "subject" emerges within human practical activity; such subjects are influenced by certain representations/ideologies that unconsciously govern the actions and thoughts of these "subjects." Although these "subjects" are themselves produced by ideology and representation, they believe themselves to be the producers. Ideology "closes off" the meaning and interpretation of the "text," constraining the "subject" so that the "ego" can maintain its continuity — thereby "closing off" the subject's own contradictoriness.
Beyond the views of ideology held by the structuralists above, there are also the views of the Historicist school and of psychoanalysis, among others. For reasons of space, we will only briefly introduce the concepts of the historicists (Gramsci, Mannheim, and Goldmann, among others).
**Gramsci** holds that ideology is the superstructural expression of a contradictory reality; structure and superstructure together form a "Historical Bloc" [the superstructure being a reflection of the relations of production in society]. The superstructure exists objectively, and it is through the superstructure that human beings become conscious of their position and their goals. Ideology is the worldview of a class, and Marxism is the "ideology" that is "most conscious of class contradiction." Western society is governed chiefly by civil society, and the ruling class is able to use ideological hegemony to control other strata.
**Mannheim** believes that culture and its products can be analyzed through the contemporary worldview (_Weltanschauung_). The process of cultural objectivation carries meaning on three levels: objective meaning [the cognition of certain acts]; expressive meaning [the subjective intention of the subject]; and documentary meaning [the overall significance of an analysis of action]. The interpretation of documentary meaning is shaped by the interpreter's own position within history.
When an author connects his thought to his own social position, "self-relativization" occurs. The concept of ideology develops through precisely this process. Viewed historically, ideology develops from an individual (particular) conception into a total conception; Mannheim terms a universal, total conception of this kind the "sociology of knowledge."
The particular conception of ideology is directed only at a partial critique of consciousness, drawing out the errors it contains; the particular conception operates at the psychological level. The total conception, by contrast, concerns the worldview of an entire era or society as a whole, and its scope of operation is social.
Once the sociology of knowledge can be established, a "general total conception" turns all social knowledge into a matter of scientific inquiry; its task is to relativize the thought of every society. In other words, the theory of ideology serves to expose the falsity and concealment practiced by human interest groups (political parties, for instance), while the sociology of knowledge analyzes the partiality of knowledge as such — since knowledge is, in this view, socially determined.
**Goldmann** put forward "genetic structuralism," believing that human behavior can be explained through a "significative structure" proposed by the researcher: each local structure can be explained by a broader structure, and this local structure can in turn be clarified by its own internal description. Social phenomena can only be explained through the structures that organize them, and these organizing structures are themselves the product of human practical activity — historically situated in time, and changing as they develop.
In analyzing a "text," Goldmann uses class _Weltanschauung_ as his structure. Literary and philosophical works are treated as the transposition of a class worldview. He holds that ideology is partial and distorted, and that its function is to preserve the position and interests of a class.
**References:**  
Jorge Larrain, _The Concept of Ideology_  
Coward and Ellis, _Language and Materialism_  
Mannheim, _Ideology and Utopia_

## Chinese
### Grok 4.5 | Aug 23, 2026 | Wissen
- 核心先驗：意識形態作為結構必然的幻象關係，主體由絕對主體透過反射鏡結構構成；物質基礎被設定為已括號的前提。
- 證據更新路徑：從阿爾杜塞的意識形態國家機器，轉向巴特二次符號系統、克里斯蒂娃意義生產過程，再至葛蘭西霸權與曼海姆知識社會學，逐步納入歷史與實踐維度。
- 可證偽性：若主體能在無意識形態機器介入下自主產生意義，或霸權無法維持歷史組合，則結構先驗將被挑戰。
- 方法演化：由純結構分析轉向發生結構主義與相對化知識，承認詮釋者歷史位置對「文據意義」的影響。

- **知識論核心：** 文本以一連串理論家與概念的接續構成論證權威：Althusser、Barthes、Kristeva、Lacan、Gramsci、Mannheim、Goldmann 等形成知識更新鏈，但文本較少展示逐項證據如何使作者改變信念。
- **證據與可證偽性：** 其主要「證據」是概念之間的結構同構與解釋力，而非經驗資料；因此其理論強項在於重新描述意識形態，弱項則是難以明確指定何種觀察結果可以使核心命題被否證。
- **方法演化：** 知識框架由「意識形態如何運作」推進至「主體如何被意識形態構成」，顯示解釋層次不斷向後退；但沒有足夠文本材料判定這是經驗更新、理論閱讀累積，還是修辭性的理論升級。
- **方法論盲點：** 以 Popper/Bayes 衡量時，文本傾向把反例重新吸收進更高階結構，而非設定明確失敗條件；模型亦不能僅憑此頁可靠判定作者對 Marxism、結構主義或後結構主義的實際信念概率如何變化。

- 文本視角從結構馬克思主義（阿爾杜塞主體範疇與反射鏡）平穩移向符號學—精神分析（巴特、克里斯蒂娃、Coward & Ellis），再轉入歷史主義（葛蘭西、曼海姆、高德曼），呈現理論視域的連續融合。
- 視域融合體現於「主體」概念的重新詮釋：由絕對主體的構成，過渡至意義生產過程與階級世界觀的轉移，各理論被置於同一論述空間對話。
- 人際修辭採取中立綜述姿態，作者隱身於引述之後，僅以「我們只粗略地介紹」標示選擇邊界，避免強勢介入。
- 修辭策略透過並列不同學派並附參考書目，邀請讀者在既有理論地平上自行延伸詮釋。
